result.topic_en: Linear relations among points A, B, C, D, E (and a, b, c, d, e) with parameters p, q, r, s, apparently coordinates of the vertices of the pentagramma mirificum configuration, written on the back of an envelope.
result.transcription:
$A = pB - qC + (1-p+q)E$
$D = -rB + sC + (1+r-s)E$

$(1+r)a = \cdot\ sC + (1+r-s)E$
$(1+q)d = pB\ \cdot + (1-p+q)E$
$(p+r)b = \cdot\ (ps-qr)C + (p+r-ps+qr)E$
$(q+s)c = (ps-qr)B\ \cdot + (q+s-ps+qr)E$
$(1+q+r-ps+qr)e = p(1+r-s)B + s(1-p+q)C + (1-p+q)(1+r-s)E$

$A + qC = (1+q)d$
$rB + D = (1+r)a$
$sA + qD = (q+s)c$
$rA + pD = (p+r)b$
$(1+r-s)A + (q+s-ps+qr)C = (1+q+r-ps+qr)e$
$+(p+r+ps-qr)B + (1-p+q)D = (1+q+r-ps+qr)e$

$\frac{(p+r)}{ps-qr}\cdot b$
$+\frac{q+s}{ps-qr}\, c$

$sA + qD = (ps-qr)B + (q+s-ps+qr)E$
$rA + pD = (ps-qr)C + (p+r-ps+qr)E$
$\left.\begin{matrix}(1+r-s)A\\ -(1-p+q)D\end{matrix}\right\} = (p+r-ps+qr)B - (q+s-ps+qr)C$

methods.what: Expression of points A and D as linear (affine) combinations of B, C, E
Derived points a, d, b, c as combinations of B, C, E
Expression of point e in terms of B, C, E
Points d, a, c, b, e as lying on lines through pairs of the original points (collinearity relations)
Elimination of E from the combinations of A and D
Linear combinations sA+qD and rA+pD in terms of B, C, E
